fields.System.Title: OUT-502 — Verify carton contents against the order
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a packer, I want the system to check the box against the order before I close it, so
that short and wrong shipments are caught here rather than by the customer.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an order whose cartons together match the picked quantities, then packing can
  • complete.
  • - Given a missing item, then completion is blocked and the missing lines are listed.
  • - Given an order cancelled during picking, then packing is blocked when the status is
  • re-checked at pack start.
  • - Given a short-picked line, then the expected pack quantity is the picked quantity, not
  • the ordered quantity.
  • - Given completion, then the order status becomes packed.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | carton, carton_content, order_line |
| Risks | Items from a cancelled order shipped ([doc 05 WF 7](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
